## 3. Helper functions

```{r s03}
clean_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NULL", "<NA>", "N/A")] <- NA
  x
}
clean_num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(clean_chr(x)))
num_word <- function(n) c("one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten", "eleven", "twelve")[n]
and_list <- function(x) if (length(x) <= 1) as.character(x) else paste(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), "and", x[length(x)])
fix_crs <- function(x, crs) {
  if (is.na(st_crs(x))) {
    st_crs(x) <- crs
  } else if (st_crs(x) != st_crs(crs)) {
    x <- st_transform(x, crs)
  }
  if (!isTRUE(st_crs(x)$epsg == crs)) x <- suppressWarnings(st_set_crs(x, crs))
  x
}
assign_to_polygons <- function(pts, polys, id_col, tolerance = attribution_tolerance_m) {
  hits <- st_intersects(pts, polys)
  n_hits <- lengths(hits)
  id <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(pts))
  dist_m <- rep(0, nrow(pts))
  one <- which(n_hits == 1)
  id[one] <- polys[[id_col]][vapply(hits[one], function(h) h[1], integer(1))]
  zero <- which(n_hits == 0)
  if (length(zero) > 0) {
    nn <- st_nearest_feature(pts[zero, ], polys)
    d <- as.numeric(st_distance(pts[zero, ], polys[nn, ], by_element = TRUE))
    dist_m[zero] <- d
    ok <- d <= tolerance
    id[zero[ok]] <- polys[[id_col]][nn[ok]]
  }
  list(id = id, n_hits = n_hits, dist_m = dist_m)
}
attribution_row <- function(label, a) {
  data.frame(
    attribution = label,
    points = length(a$id),
    inside_one_polygon = sum(a$n_hits == 1),
    inside_several_polygons = sum(a$n_hits > 1),
    nearest_within_tolerance = sum(a$n_hits == 0 & !is.na(a$id)),
    unassigned = sum(is.na(a$id)),
    max_distance_outside_m = max(a$dist_m)
  )
}
drennan_quartiles <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(x[!is.na(x)])
  n <- length(x)
  if (n == 0) return(c(q1 = NA_real_, median = NA_real_, q3 = NA_real_))
  k <- ceiling(n / 4)
  c(q1 = x[k], median = stats::median(x), q3 = x[n - k + 1])
}
trimmed_mean <- function(x, f = trim_fraction) {
  x <- sort(x[!is.na(x)])
  n <- length(x)
  k <- ceiling(f * n)
  if (n - 2 * k < 1) return(NA_real_)
  mean(x[(k + 1):(n - k)])
}
trimmed_sd <- function(x, f = trim_fraction) {
  x <- sort(x[!is.na(x)])
  n <- length(x)
  k <- ceiling(f * n)
  nt <- n - 2 * k
  if (nt < 2) return(NA_real_)
  xw <- x
  if (k > 0) {
    xw[seq_len(k)] <- x[k + 1]
    xw[(n - k + 1):n] <- x[n - k]
  }
  sqrt((n - 1) * stats::var(xw) / (nt - 1))
}
describe_batch <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  q <- drennan_quartiles(x)
  s <- if (length(x) > 1) stats::sd(x) else NA_real_
  data.frame(
    n = length(x),
    min = min(x),
    q1 = unname(q[["q1"]]),
    median = unname(q[["median"]]),
    q3 = unname(q[["q3"]]),
    max = max(x),
    midspread = unname(q[["q3"]] - q[["q1"]]),
    mean = mean(x),
    trimmed_mean = trimmed_mean(x),
    sd = s,
    trimmed_sd = trimmed_sd(x),
    skew_index = (mean(x) - unname(q[["median"]])) / s
  )
}
drennan_box <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  q <- drennan_quartiles(x)
  m <- unname(q[["q3"]] - q[["q1"]])
  inner_low <- unname(q[["q1"]]) - 1.5 * m
  inner_high <- unname(q[["q3"]]) + 1.5 * m
  outer_low <- unname(q[["q1"]]) - 3 * m
  outer_high <- unname(q[["q3"]]) + 3 * m
  inside <- x[x >= inner_low & x <= inner_high]
  data.frame(
    n = length(x),
    q1 = unname(q[["q1"]]),
    median = unname(q[["median"]]),
    q3 = unname(q[["q3"]]),
    midspread = m,
    whisker_low = min(inside),
    whisker_high = max(inside),
    inner_low = inner_low,
    inner_high = inner_high,
    outer_low = outer_low,
    outer_high = outer_high,
    n_outliers = sum(x < inner_low | x > inner_high),
    n_far_outliers = sum(x < outer_low | x > outer_high)
  )
}
cluster_ratio <- function(x, y, conf = conf_levels, bounded = TRUE) {
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y) & y > 0
  x <- x[keep]
  y <- y[keep]
  n <- length(y)
  p <- sum(x) / sum(y)
  se <- if (n >= 2) sqrt(sum((x - p * y)^2) / ((n - 1) * n * mean(y)^2)) else NA_real_
  out <- data.frame(estimate = p, se = se, n_units = n, n_elements = sum(y))
  for (cl in conf) {
    tcrit <- if (n >= 2) stats::qt(1 - (1 - cl) / 2, df = n - 1) else NA_real_
    lo <- p - tcrit * se
    hi <- p + tcrit * se
    if (bounded) {
      lo <- max(0, lo)
      hi <- min(1, hi)
    }
    out[[paste0("lo", round(cl * 100))]] <- lo
    out[[paste0("hi", round(cl * 100))]] <- hi
  }
  out
}
mean_range <- function(v, conf = conf_levels) {
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  n <- length(v)
  se <- if (n >= 2) stats::sd(v) / sqrt(n) else NA_real_
  out <- data.frame(estimate = mean(v), se = se, n_units = n)
  for (cl in conf) {
    tcrit <- if (n >= 2) stats::qt(1 - (1 - cl) / 2, df = n - 1) else NA_real_
    out[[paste0("lo", round(cl * 100))]] <- mean(v) - tcrit * se
    out[[paste0("hi", round(cl * 100))]] <- mean(v) + tcrit * se
  }
  out
}
percentile_ranges <- function(reps, conf = conf_levels) {
  reps <- reps[is.finite(reps)]
  res <- numeric(0)
  for (cl in conf) {
    a <- (1 - cl) / 2
    res[paste0("lo", round(cl * 100))] <- if (length(reps) > 0) stats::quantile(reps, a, names = FALSE) else NA_real_
    res[paste0("hi", round(cl * 100))] <- if (length(reps) > 0) stats::quantile(reps, 1 - a, names = FALSE) else NA_real_
  }
  as.data.frame(as.list(res))
}
zero_confidence <- function(n, p = 0.05) 1 - (1 - p)^n
zero_upper_bound <- function(n, conf = 0.95) 1 - (1 - conf)^(1 / n)
fmt_num <- function(x, d = 3) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d))
print_block <- function(title, df, digits = 3) {
  cat("\n", paste(strwrap(title, width = getOption("width")), collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  num <- vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))
  df[num] <- lapply(df[num], function(v) round(v, digits))
  print(df, row.names = FALSE)
  invisible(NULL)
}
bullet_layers <- function(tick_width = 0.2) {
  list(
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo99, ymax = hi99), linewidth = 0.3),
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95), linewidth = 0.9),
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo80, ymax = hi80), linewidth = 1.8),
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate, ymax = estimate), width = tick_width, linewidth = 0.5)
  )
}
fig_files <- data.frame(figure = character(0), width_mm = numeric(0), height_mm = numeric(0), dpi = numeric(0), tiff_mb = numeric(0), pdf_mb = numeric(0))
save_fig <- function(plot, name, height_mm) {
  if (!export_figures) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (name %in% online_only) name <- paste0(name, "_online_only")
  use_cairo <- isTRUE(capabilities("cairo"))
  tiff_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".tiff"))
  pdf_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf"))
  tiff_args <- list(filename = tiff_file, plot = plot, width = fig_width_mm, height = height_mm, units = "mm", dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
  if (use_cairo) tiff_args$type <- "cairo"
  do.call(ggsave, tiff_args)
  ggsave(pdf_file, plot, width = fig_width_mm, height = height_mm, units = "mm", device = if (use_cairo) grDevices::cairo_pdf else "pdf")
  fig_files <<- rbind(fig_files[fig_files$figure != name, , drop = FALSE], data.frame(figure = name, width_mm = fig_width_mm, height_mm = height_mm, dpi = 600, tiff_mb = file.size(tiff_file) / 1024^2, pdf_mb = file.size(pdf_file) / 1024^2))
  invisible(NULL)
}
ge_label <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- x
  out[x == "Steps >= 1"] <- "Steps \u2265 1"
  out[x == "Steps >= 1, undecorated"] <- "Steps \u2265 1, undecorated"
  out
}
timings <- data.frame(step = character(0), seconds = numeric(0))
time_step <- function(step, expr) {
  t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  value <- force(expr)
  timings <<- rbind(timings, data.frame(step = step, seconds = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0))
  value
}
run_chunk <- function(m, fun, ...) lapply(seq_len(m), function(i) fun(...))
par_reps <- function(B, fun, seed, ...) {
  k <- min(n_chunks, B)
  sizes <- rep(B %/% k, k) + rep(c(1L, 0L), c(B %% k, k - B %% k))
  out <- future.apply::future_lapply(sizes, run_chunk, fun = fun, ..., future.seed = as.integer(seed))
  unlist(out, recursive = FALSE)
}
boot_rim_once <- function(rim_rows, values, grp) {
  s <- sample.int(length(rim_rows), length(rim_rows), replace = TRUE)
  r <- unlist(rim_rows[s], use.names = FALSE)
  tapply(values[r], grp[r], stats::median)
}
boot_distinct_D <- function(dm, n_vars) {
  m <- nrow(dm)
  s <- sample.int(m, m, replace = TRUE)
  sub <- dm[s, s]
  keep <- outer(s, s, "!=") & upper.tri(sub)
  mean(sub[keep]) / n_vars
}
null_D_once <- function(pool, n_i, mu, sdv, num_idx, den_idx) {
  idx <- sample.int(nrow(pool))
  g <- rep(seq_along(n_i), n_i)
  rs <- rowsum(pool[idx, , drop = FALSE], g)
  props <- rs[, num_idx, drop = FALSE] / rs[, den_idx, drop = FALSE]
  props[!is.finite(props)] <- 0
  z <- sweep(sweep(props, 2, mu, "-"), 2, sdv, "/")
  mean(stats::dist(z)) / ncol(z)
}
null_D_loc_once <- function(pool, g, strata_list, mu, sdv, num_idx, den_idx) {
  g2 <- g
  for (s in strata_list) if (length(s) > 1) g2[s] <- g[s][sample.int(length(s))]
  rs <- rowsum(pool, g2)
  props <- rs[, num_idx, drop = FALSE] / rs[, den_idx, drop = FALSE]
  props[!is.finite(props)] <- 0
  z <- sweep(sweep(props, 2, mu, "-"), 2, sdv, "/")
  mean(stats::dist(z)) / ncol(z)
}
mantel_once <- function(dz, dg) {
  s <- sample.int(nrow(dz))
  stats::cor(as.vector(stats::as.dist(dz[s, s])), dg)
}
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", ifelse(p < 0.0001, "< 0.0001", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4)))
p_log <- data.frame(where = character(0), quantity = character(0), p = numeric(0), resampling = logical(0))
register_p <- function(where, quantity, p, resampling = FALSE) {
  p_log <<- rbind(p_log, data.frame(where = where, quantity = quantity, p = p, resampling = resampling))
  invisible(p)
}
format_p_columns <- function(df, cols) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  for (cl in cols) df[[cl]] <- fmt_p(df[[cl]])
  df
}
gini_vec <- function(v, unbiased = FALSE) {
  v <- sort(v[is.finite(v)])
  n <- length(v)
  tot <- sum(v)
  if (n < 2 || tot <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  g <- sum((2 * seq_len(n) - n - 1) * v) / (n * tot)
  if (unbiased) g * n / (n - 1) else g
}
lorenz_curve <- function(v) {
  v <- sort(v[is.finite(v)])
  data.frame(p = c(0, seq_along(v) / length(v)), L = c(0, cumsum(v) / sum(v)))
}
lorenz_at <- function(v, grid) {
  v <- sort(v[is.finite(v)])
  n <- length(v)
  stats::approx(c(0, seq_len(n) / n), c(0, cumsum(v) / sum(v)), xout = grid)$y
}
top_share_of <- function(v, top) {
  v <- sort(v[is.finite(v)], decreasing = TRUE)
  sum(v[seq_len(max(1, ceiling(top * length(v))))]) / sum(v)
}
boot_cluster_once <- function(vals_list, stat, ...) {
  k <- length(vals_list)
  stat(unlist(vals_list[sample.int(k, k, replace = TRUE)], use.names = FALSE), ...)
}
boot_mean_once <- function(vals) mean(vals[sample.int(length(vals), length(vals), replace = TRUE)])
perm_alpha_once <- function(vals, sizes, stat, unbiased) {
  v <- vals[sample.int(length(vals))]
  a <- vapply(split(v, rep.int(seq_along(sizes), sizes)), stat, numeric(1), unbiased = unbiased)
  c(mean_alpha = mean(a), beta = stats::sd(a))
}
draw_alpha_once <- function(vals, n_values, stat, unbiased) {
  vapply(n_values, function(k) stat(vals[sample.int(length(vals), k)], unbiased = unbiased), numeric(1))
}
null_gini_sherds_once <- function(num, sizes, stat, unbiased) {
  v <- num[sample.int(length(num))]
  stat(rowsum(v, rep.int(seq_along(sizes), sizes), reorder = FALSE)[, 1] / sizes, unbiased = unbiased)
}
null_gini_loc_once <- function(num_loc, den_loc, g, strata_list, stat, unbiased) {
  g2 <- g
  for (s in strata_list) if (length(s) > 1) g2[s] <- g[s][sample.int(length(s))]
  stat(rowsum(num_loc, g2)[, 1] / rowsum(den_loc, g2)[, 1], unbiased = unbiased)
}
```

```{r s05}
download_input <- function(file) {
  url <- paste(raw_base, file, sep = "/")
  dest <- file.path(data_dir, file)
  ok <- tryCatch(utils::download.file(url, dest, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE) == 0, error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (!isTRUE(ok) || !file.exists(dest) || file.size(dest) == 0) stop("Could not download ", file, " from ", url)
  dest
}
input_paths <- vapply(unname(inputs), download_input, character(1))
download_check <- data.frame(
  layer = names(inputs),
  file = unname(inputs),
  bytes = unname(file.size(input_paths)),
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(input_paths)),
  expected_md5 = unname(expected_md5[names(inputs)])
) |>
  mutate(match = md5 == expected_md5)
print_block(paste("Inputs downloaded from", raw_base), download_check)
if (check_md5) stopifnot(all(download_check$match))
load_rdata <- function(file, object) {
  env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  found <- load(file.path(data_dir, file), envir = env)
  if (!(object %in% found)) {
    stopifnot(length(found) == 1)
    object <- found
  }
  x <- get(object, envir = env)
  stopifnot(inherits(x, "sf"))
  x
}
layers <- lapply(names(inputs), function(k) fix_crs(load_rdata(inputs[[k]], object_names[[k]]), crs_utm))
names(layers) <- names(inputs)
print_block("Imported layers", data.frame(layer = names(inputs), file = unname(inputs), features = vapply(layers, nrow, integer(1)), geometry = vapply(layers, function(x) paste(unique(as.character(st_geometry_type(x))), collapse = ", "), character(1))))
```

## 6. Cleaning, coding checks and spatial attribution

```{r s06}
numeric_fields <- c("Size_HA", "Tot_sherds", "Cooking", "Serving", "Storage", "Decorated", "Terr_num")
sites_sf <- st_make_valid(layers$tairona_sites) |>
  select(any_of("Size_HA")) |>
  mutate(Site_ID = sprintf("T%03d", seq_len(n())), Size_HA = clean_num(Size_HA))
sites_sf$area_geometry_ha <- as.numeric(st_area(sites_sf)) / 10000
terraces_sf <- layers$tairona_terraces |>
  select(any_of("Diam_Terra")) |>
  mutate(Diam_Terra = clean_num(Diam_Terra))
a_terr <- assign_to_polygons(terraces_sf, sites_sf, "Site_ID")
terraces_sf$Site_ID <- a_terr$id
terr_by_site <- st_drop_geometry(terraces_sf) |>
  filter(!is.na(Site_ID)) |>
  group_by(Site_ID) |>
  summarise(N_Terraces = n(), Diam_Mean = mean(Diam_Terra, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
sites_sf <- sites_sf |>
  left_join(terr_by_site, by = "Site_ID") |>
  mutate(
    N_Terraces = ifelse(is.na(N_Terraces), 0, N_Terraces),
    Site_Type = cut(Size_HA, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.5, 1, Inf), right = FALSE, labels = size_classes),
    Unit_ID = Site_ID,
    Period_unit = "Tairona"
  )
prep_units <- function(units, terr, prefix, period) {
  units <- st_make_valid(units) |>
    select(any_of(numeric_fields)) |>
    mutate(across(any_of(numeric_fields), clean_num)) |>
    mutate(Unit_ID = sprintf(paste0(prefix, "%03d"), seq_len(n())), Period_unit = period)
  terr <- terr |>
    select(any_of("Diam_Terra")) |>
    mutate(Diam_Terra = clean_num(Diam_Terra))
  a <- assign_to_polygons(terr, units, "Unit_ID")
  terr$Unit_ID <- a$id
  by_unit <- st_drop_geometry(terr) |>
    filter(!is.na(Unit_ID)) |>
    group_by(Unit_ID) |>
    summarise(N_Terraces = n(), Diam_Mean = mean(Diam_Terra, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  units <- units |>
    left_join(by_unit, by = "Unit_ID") |>
    mutate(
      N_Terraces = ifelse(is.na(N_Terraces), 0, N_Terraces),
      Site_Type = cut(Size_HA, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.5, 1, Inf), right = FALSE, labels = size_classes)
    )
  list(units = units, attribution = attribution_row(paste(period, "terraces to", period, "units"), a))
}
```

## 7. Analytical units

```{r s07}
summarise_assemblages <- function(df, id) {
  df |>
    group_by(Period, across(all_of(id))) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      n_locations = n_distinct(Location_ID),
      decorated = sum(decorated),
      slip = sum(slip),
      incision = sum(incision),
      prod1 = sum(prod1),
      steps12 = sum(steps12),
      prod3 = sum(prod3),
      core = sum(core),
      plain = sum(plain),
      plain_step = sum(plain_step),
      fun_rec = sum(fun_rec),
      serving = sum(serving),
      storage = sum(storage),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      p_decorated = decorated / n,
      p_slip = slip / n,
      p_incision = incision / n,
      p_prod1 = prod1 / n,
      p_steps12 = steps12 / n,
      p_prod3 = prod3 / n,
      p_core = core / n,
      p_plain_step = ifelse(plain > 0, plain_step / plain, NA_real_),
      p_serving = ifelse(fun_rec >= min_functional, serving / fun_rec, NA_real_),
      p_storage = ifelse(fun_rec >= min_functional, storage / fun_rec, NA_real_),
      qualified = n >= min_sherds_site
    )
}
```

## 11. Figure 2, Q1 regional composition by period

```{r s11, fig.width = fig_width_mm / 25.4, fig.height = 175 / 25.4, fig.cap = captions[["fig2"]]}
est_binary <- bind_rows(lapply(periods, function(pr) {
  d <- unit_period |> filter(Period == pr)
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(binary_spec)), function(j) {
    cbind(data.frame(Period = pr, attribute = binary_spec$label[j]), cluster_ratio(d[[binary_spec$var[j]]], d[[binary_spec$den[j]]]))
  }))
})) |>
  mutate(Period = factor(Period, levels = periods), attribute = factor(attribute, levels = binary_spec$label))
est_category <- function(var, levels) {
  d <- sherds |> filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]))
  bind_rows(lapply(periods, function(pr) {
    dp <- d |> filter(Period == pr)
    totals <- dp |> count(Unit_ID, name = "y")
    bind_rows(lapply(levels, function(lv) {
      num <- dp |> filter(.data[[var]] == lv) |> count(Unit_ID, name = "x")
      m <- totals |> left_join(num, by = "Unit_ID") |> mutate(x = ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))
      cbind(data.frame(Period = pr, category = lv), cluster_ratio(m$x, m$y))
    }))
  })) |>
    mutate(Period = factor(Period, levels = periods), category = factor(category, levels = levels))
}
est_form <- est_category("Vessel_for", form_levels)
est_function <- est_category("Function", function_levels)
p4a <- ggplot(est_binary, aes(x = Period, y = estimate)) +
  bullet_layers() +
```

## 16. Q2 and Q3 degree of differentiation with controls

```{r s16}
build_mv <- function(threshold) {
  q <- unit_period |> filter(n >= threshold, plain >= 1)
  cnt <- q |> count(Period, name = "sites")
  keep_p <- as.character(cnt$Period[cnt$sites >= min_sites_period])
  q <- q |>
    filter(Period %in% keep_p) |>
    mutate(Period = factor(as.character(Period), levels = periods[periods %in% keep_p]))
  raw <- as.matrix(q[, mv_vars])
  use <- mv_vars[apply(raw, 2, stats::sd) > 0]
  mu <- colMeans(raw[, use, drop = FALSE])
  sdv <- apply(raw[, use, drop = FALSE], 2, stats::sd)
  z <- sweep(sweep(raw[, use, drop = FALSE], 2, mu, "-"), 2, sdv, "/")
  list(data = q, z = z, use = use, mu = mu, sdv = sdv)
}
degree_period <- function(mv, pr, seed, with_ranges = TRUE) {
  idx <- which(mv$data$Period == pr)
  zp <- mv$z[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  dm <- as.matrix(stats::dist(zp))
  nv <- ncol(zp)
  m <- length(idx)
  D_obs <- sum(dm[upper.tri(dm)]) / (m * (m - 1) / 2) / nv
  pool_rows <- which(sherds$Period == pr & sherds$Unit_ID %in% mv$data$Unit_ID[idx])
  spec <- mv_spec[match(mv$use, mv_spec$var), ]
  pool <- cbind(as.matrix(sherds[pool_rows, pool_cols]) * 1, all = 1)
  num_idx <- match(spec$num, colnames(pool))
  den_idx <- match(spec$den, colnames(pool))
  stopifnot(nrow(pool) == sum(mv$data$n[idx]), !anyNA(num_idx), !anyNA(den_idx))
  nul <- unlist(par_reps(n_null, null_D_once, seed + 100L, pool = pool, n_i = mv$data$n[idx], mu = mv$mu, sdv = mv$sdv, num_idx = num_idx, den_idx = den_idx))
  loc_tab <- sherds[pool_rows, c("Unit_ID", "Location_ID", pool_cols)] |>
    group_by(Unit_ID, Location_ID) |>
    summarise(across(all_of(pool_cols), sum), all = n(), .groups = "drop")
  pool_loc <- as.matrix(loc_tab[, c(pool_cols, "all")])
  g_loc <- match(loc_tab$Unit_ID, mv$data$Unit_ID[idx])
  ord <- order(pool_loc[, "all"], loc_tab$Location_ID)
  stratum <- integer(nrow(pool_loc))
  stratum[ord] <- ceiling(seq_along(ord) / location_stratum_size)
  strata_list <- split(seq_len(nrow(pool_loc)), stratum)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(g_loc), sum(pool_loc[, "all"]) == nrow(pool), identical(colnames(pool_loc), colnames(pool)))
  nul_loc <- unlist(par_reps(n_null, null_D_loc_once, seed + 300L, pool = pool_loc, g = g_loc, strata_list = strata_list, mu = mv$mu, sdv = mv$sdv, num_idx = num_idx, den_idx = den_idx))
  out <- data.frame(
    Period = pr,
    sites = m,
    estimate = D_obs,
    expected_by_chance = mean(nul),
    chance_lo95 = unname(stats::quantile(nul, 0.025)),
    chance_hi95 = unname(stats::quantile(nul, 0.975)),
    excess = D_obs - mean(nul),
    ratio = D_obs / mean(nul),
    p_chance = (sum(nul >= D_obs) + 1) / (length(nul) + 1),
    expected_by_location_chance = mean(nul_loc),
    location_lo95 = unname(stats::quantile(nul_loc, 0.025)),
    location_hi95 = unname(stats::quantile(nul_loc, 0.975)),
    excess_over_locations = D_obs - mean(nul_loc),
    p_location = (sum(nul_loc >= D_obs - 1e-12) + 1) / (length(nul_loc) + 1),
    locations = nrow(pool_loc),
    location_strata = length(strata_list),
    median_size_ratio_in_strata = stats::median(vapply(strata_list, function(s) max(pool_loc[s, "all"]) / min(pool_loc[s, "all"]), numeric(1)))
  )
  if (!with_ranges) return(list(summary = out))
  boot <- unlist(par_reps(n_boot, boot_distinct_D, seed + 200L, dm = dm, n_vars = nv))
  out <- cbind(out, percentile_ranges(boot))
  sites <- data.frame(Period = pr, Unit_ID = mv$data$Unit_ID[idx], Site_Type = mv$data$Site_Type[idx], sherds = mv$data$n[idx], mean_distance = rowSums(dm) / (m - 1) / nv)
  list(summary = out, sites = sites)
}
mv19 <- build_mv(min_sherds_site)
periods_mv <- levels(mv19$data$Period)
deg_list <- time_step("Degree of differentiation with error ranges and chance expectation", lapply(periods_mv, function(pr) degree_period(mv19, pr, seed_base + 10L * match(pr, periods))))
deg_main <- bind_rows(lapply(deg_list, function(z) z$summary)) |> mutate(Period = factor(Period, levels = periods_mv))
site_dist <- bind_rows(lapply(deg_list, function(z) z$sites)) |> mutate(Period = factor(Period, levels = periods_mv))
box7 <- site_dist |> group_by(Period) |> group_modify(~ drennan_box(.x$mean_distance)) |> ungroup()
site_dist <- site_dist |>
  left_join(box7 |> select(Period, inner_low, inner_high, outer_low, outer_high), by = "Period") |>
  mutate(outlier = mean_distance < inner_low | mean_distance > inner_high, far_outlier = mean_distance < outer_low | mean_distance > outer_high)
far19 <- site_dist |> filter(far_outlier)
keep_nf <- !(paste(mv19$data$Period, mv19$data$Unit_ID) %in% paste(far19$Period, far19$Unit_ID))
mv19_nf <- list(data = mv19$data[keep_nf, ], z = mv19$z[keep_nf, , drop = FALSE], use = mv19$use, mu = mv19$mu, sdv = mv19$sdv)
summary_cols <- c("Period", "sites", "estimate", "expected_by_chance", "chance_lo95", "chance_hi95", "excess", "ratio", "p_chance", "expected_by_location_chance", "location_lo95", "location_hi95", "excess_over_locations", "p_location", "locations", "location_strata", "median_size_ratio_in_strata")
main_summary <- function(pr) deg_main |> filter(Period == pr) |> mutate(Period = as.character(Period)) |> select(all_of(summary_cols))
without_far <- time_step("Control without far outliers", bind_rows(lapply(levels(mv19_nf$data$Period), function(pr) {
  n_removed <- sum(far19$Period == pr)
  s <- if (n_removed == 0) main_summary(pr) else degree_period(mv19_nf, pr, seed_base + 400L + match(pr, periods), with_ranges = FALSE)$summary
  cbind(data.frame(far_outliers_removed = n_removed), s)
})))
sensitivity7 <- time_step("Control with alternative minima", bind_rows(lapply(sensitivity_thresholds, function(th) {
  mv_t <- build_mv(th)
  bind_rows(lapply(levels(mv_t$data$Period), function(pr) {
    s <- if (th == min_sherds_site) main_summary(pr) else degree_period(mv_t, pr, seed_base + 1000L + 10L * th + match(pr, periods), with_ranges = FALSE)$summary
    cbind(data.frame(minimum = th), s)
  }))
})))
rank7 <- sensitivity7 |>
  group_by(minimum) |>
  mutate(rank_by_estimate = rank(-estimate), rank_by_excess = rank(-excess)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(minimum, Period, estimate, excess, rank_by_estimate, rank_by_excess)
far_diag <- sherds |>
  mutate(Period = as.character(Period)) |>
  semi_join(far19 |> transmute(Period = as.character(Period), Unit_ID), by = c("Period", "Unit_ID")) |>
  group_by(Period, Unit_ID) |>
  summarise(
    sherds = n(),
    collection_locations = n_distinct(Location_ID),
    ceramic_types = n_distinct(Ceramic_ty),
    vessel_forms_recorded = n_distinct(stats::na.omit(Vessel_for)),
    rims_measured = sum(!is.na(Rim_cm)),
    p_slip = mean(slip),
    p_prod3 = mean(prod3),
    p_plain_step = sum(plain_step) / sum(plain),
    p_core = mean(core),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
locations7 <- unit_period |>
  filter(qualified) |>
  group_by(Period) |>
  summarise(assemblages = n(), single_location = sum(n_locations == 1), median_locations = stats::median(n_locations), max_locations = max(n_locations), .groups = "drop")
keep_multi <- mv19$data$n_locations >= 2
mv19_multi <- list(data = mv19$data[keep_multi, ], z = mv19$z[keep_multi, , drop = FALSE], use = mv19$use, mu = mv19$mu, sdv = mv19$sdv)
periods_multi <- periods_mv[vapply(periods_mv, function(pr) sum(mv19_multi$data$Period == pr) >= min_sites_period, logical(1))]
single_location7 <- time_step("Control without single-location assemblages", bind_rows(lapply(periods_multi, function(pr) {
  cbind(data.frame(single_location_removed = sum(mv19$data$Period == pr & !keep_multi)), degree_period(mv19_multi, pr, seed_base + 600L + match(pr, periods), with_ranges = FALSE)$summary)
})))
centroids_xy <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(units_sf)))
rownames(centroids_xy) <- units_sf$Unit_ID
spatial7 <- time_step("Control for spatial structure", bind_rows(lapply(periods_mv, function(pr) {
  idx <- which(mv19$data$Period == pr)
  dz <- as.matrix(stats::dist(mv19$z[idx, , drop = FALSE]))
  dg <- as.vector(stats::dist(centroids_xy[mv19$data$Unit_ID[idx], , drop = FALSE])) / 1000
  r_obs <- stats::cor(as.vector(stats::as.dist(dz)), dg)
  sims <- unlist(par_reps(n_null, mantel_once, seed_base + 500L + match(pr, periods), dz = dz, dg = dg))
  data.frame(Period = pr, units = length(idx), r_assemblage_distance_vs_km = r_obs, p_permutation = (sum(abs(sims) >= abs(r_obs)) + 1) / (length(sims) + 1))
})))
print_block("Assemblages meeting the minimum without undecorated sherds", unit_period |> filter(qualified) |> group_by(Period) |> summarise(assemblages = n(), without_undecorated = sum(plain == 0), .groups = "drop"))
print_block("Variables in the multivariate matrix", data.frame(variable = mv19$use, label = unname(mv_labels[mv19$use]), mean = mv19$mu, sd = mv19$sdv))
```

## 19. Q3 multidimensional scaling and cluster analysis

```{r s19}
nf_key <- apply(round(mv19_nf$z, 8), 1, paste, collapse = "|")
nf_key_u <- nf_key[!duplicated(nf_key)]
d9 <- stats::dist(mv19_nf$z[!duplicated(nf_key), , drop = FALSE])
max_dim <- min(5, length(nf_key_u) - 2)
mds_fits <- time_step("Multidimensional scaling", lapply(seq_len(max_dim), function(k) MASS::isoMDS(d9, k = k, trace = FALSE)))
stress9 <- data.frame(dimensions = seq_len(max_dim), stress = vapply(mds_fits, function(f) f$stress / 100, numeric(1)))
dims_ok <- stress9$dimensions[stress9$stress <= 0.15]
chosen_dim <- if (length(dims_ok) > 0) min(dims_ok) else NA_real_
k_plot <- min(mds_k_plot, max_dim)
coords9 <- mds_fits[[k_plot]]$points[match(nf_key, nf_key_u), , drop = FALSE]
colnames(coords9) <- paste0("Dim", seq_len(ncol(coords9)))
shepard_rho <- stats::cor(as.vector(d9), as.vector(stats::dist(mds_fits[[k_plot]]$points)), method = "spearman")
shepard_by_k <- data.frame(dimensions = seq_len(max_dim), stress = stress9$stress, spearman = vapply(mds_fits, function(f) stats::cor(as.vector(d9), as.vector(stats::dist(f$points)), method = "spearman"), numeric(1)))
hc9 <- stats::hclust(d9, method = "average")
h9 <- sort(hc9$height, decreasing = TRUE)
ks <- 2:min(max_clusters, length(h9))
ksel <- bind_rows(lapply(ks, function(k) {
  memb <- stats::cutree(hc9, k = k)[match(nf_key, nf_key_u)]
  data.frame(k = k, gap = h9[k - 1] - h9[k], smallest_cluster = min(table(memb)))
})) |>
  mutate(eligible = smallest_cluster >= min_cluster_size)
k_use <- if (!is.na(k_clusters)) k_clusters else if (any(ksel$eligible)) ksel$k[ksel$eligible][which.max(ksel$gap[ksel$eligible])] else 1
cluster9 <- if (k_use > 1) stats::cutree(hc9, k = k_use)[match(nf_key, nf_key_u)] else rep(1L, length(nf_key))
df9 <- cbind(data.frame(Period = mv19_nf$data$Period, Unit_ID = mv19_nf$data$Unit_ID, Site_Type = mv19_nf$data$Site_Type), as.data.frame(coords9), data.frame(cluster = factor(cluster9)))
dim_cols <- colnames(coords9)
print_block("Assemblages in the scaling", data.frame(assemblages = nrow(df9), distinct_profiles = length(nf_key_u), far_outliers_excluded = nrow(far19)))
captions[["fig4"]] <- sprintf(captions[["fig4"]], nrow(df9), length(nf_key_u), if (k_plot == 3) " Panels show the three pairs of dimensions." else "")
stopifnot(nchar(captions[["fig4"]]) <= 350)
```

```{r s22, fig.width = fig_width_mm / 25.4, fig.height = 100 / 25.4, fig.cap = captions[["fig5"]]}
t8_all <- unit_period |>
  filter(Period == "Tairona", !is.na(N_Terraces), N_Terraces > 0) |>
  mutate(log_terraces = log10(N_Terraces))
t8 <- t8_all |> filter(qualified, !is.na(p_plain_step))
reg_vars <- c(p_decorated = "Decorated", p_slip = "Slip", p_incision = "Incision", p_prod1 = "Steps >= 1", p_plain_step = "Steps >= 1, undecorated", p_core = "Firing core", p_serving = "Serving vessels", p_storage = "Storage vessels")
counts8 <- list(p_decorated = c("decorated", "n"), p_slip = c("slip", "n"), p_incision = c("incision", "n"), p_prod1 = c("prod1", "n"), p_plain_step = c("plain_step", "plain"), p_core = c("core", "n"), p_serving = c("serving", "fun_rec"), p_storage = c("storage", "fun_rec"))
qn <- stats::qnorm(0.975)
hc3_coef <- function(fit, term) {
  V <- sandwich::vcovHC(fit, type = "HC3")
  b <- unname(stats::coef(fit)[term])
  se <- sqrt(V[term, term])
  z <- b / se
  c(estimate = b, se = se, z = z, p = 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(z)), lower95 = b - qn * se, upper95 = b + qn * se)
}
glm_fit <- function(v, data, use_minimum = TRUE, extra = NULL) {
  cols <- counts8[[v]]
  d <- data[data[[cols[2]]] > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (use_minimum) d <- d[!is.na(d[[v]]), , drop = FALSE]
  d$y_prop <- d[[cols[1]]] / d[[cols[2]]]
  d$w_den <- d[[cols[2]]]
  rhs <- paste(c("log_terraces", extra), collapse = " + ")
  fit <- stats::glm(stats::as.formula(paste("y_prop ~", rhs)), family = stats::quasibinomial(), weights = w_den, data = d)
  list(fit = fit, data = d)
}
glm_row <- function(v, g, term = "log_terraces") {
  h <- hc3_coef(g$fit, term)
  data.frame(
    index = reg_vars[[v]],
    term = term,
    sites = nrow(g$data),
    sherds_in_denominator = sum(g$data$w_den),
    slope_logit = h[["estimate"]],
    hc3_se = h[["se"]],
    z = h[["z"]],
    p = h[["p"]],
    slope_lower95 = h[["lower95"]],
    slope_upper95 = h[["upper95"]],
    odds_ratio_per_doubling = if (term == "log_terraces") exp(h[["estimate"]] * log10(2)) else exp(h[["estimate"]]),
    or_lower95 = if (term == "log_terraces") exp(h[["lower95"]] * log10(2)) else exp(h[["lower95"]]),
    or_upper95 = if (term == "log_terraces") exp(h[["upper95"]] * log10(2)) else exp(h[["upper95"]]),
    dispersion = summary(g$fit)$dispersion
  )
}
fits8 <- lapply(names(reg_vars), function(v) glm_fit(v, t8))
names(fits8) <- names(reg_vars)
coef8 <- bind_rows(lapply(names(reg_vars), function(v) glm_row(v, fits8[[v]]))) |>
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"))
resid8 <- bind_rows(lapply(names(reg_vars), function(v) {
  g <- fits8[[v]]
  data.frame(
    index = reg_vars[[v]],
    Unit_ID = g$data$Unit_ID,
    N_Terraces = g$data$N_Terraces,
    denominator = g$data$w_den,
    observed = g$data$y_prop,
    fitted = unname(stats::fitted(g$fit)),
    standardized_residual = unname(stats::rstandard(g$fit, type = "pearson"))
  )
}))
plot8_vars <- c("p_decorated", "p_plain_step")
plot8_idx <- unname(reg_vars[plot8_vars])
curve8 <- bind_rows(lapply(plot8_vars, function(v) {
  g <- fits8[[v]]
  grid <- data.frame(log_terraces = seq(min(g$data$log_terraces), max(g$data$log_terraces), length.out = 200))
  X <- cbind(1, grid$log_terraces)
  V <- sandwich::vcovHC(g$fit, type = "HC3")
  eta <- drop(X %*% stats::coef(g$fit))
  se <- sqrt(rowSums((X %*% V) * X))
  data.frame(index = reg_vars[[v]], log_terraces = grid$log_terraces, fit = stats::plogis(eta), lo95 = stats::plogis(eta - qn * se), hi95 = stats::plogis(eta + qn * se))
})) |>
  mutate(index = factor(index, levels = plot8_idx))
long8 <- resid8 |>
  filter(index %in% plot8_idx) |>
  mutate(index = factor(index, levels = plot8_idx), log_terraces = log10(N_Terraces), flagged = abs(standardized_residual) >= 2)
fig5 <- ggplot(long8, aes(x = log_terraces, y = observed)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = curve8, aes(x = log_terraces, ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95), inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey75", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = curve8, aes(x = log_terraces, y = fit), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(long8, !flagged), aes(fill = standardized_residual, size = denominator), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = filter(long8, flagged), aes(fill = standardized_residual, size = denominator), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~index, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y", labeller = as_labeller(ge_label)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Standardized\nresidual") +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 4.5), transform = "log10", breaks = c(20, 50, 200, 1000), name = "Sherds") +
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(stroke = 0.3))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = log10(c(1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50)), labels = c(1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.06))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "Terraces per site (log scale)", y = "Proportion of sherds")
print(fig5)
save_fig(fig5, "Figure_05", 100)
```

```{r s24}
multiscale_terraces <- function(min_n, seed, unbiased = gini_unbiased, with_detail = FALSE, tl = terr_list, label = "all terraces") {
  sub <- tl[lengths(tl) >= min_n]
  vals <- unlist(sub, use.names = FALSE)
  sizes <- unname(lengths(sub))
  alpha <- vapply(sub, gini_vec, numeric(1), unbiased = unbiased)
  gamma_sub <- gini_vec(vals, unbiased)
  perm <- do.call(rbind, par_reps(n_null, perm_alpha_once, seed, vals = vals, sizes = sizes, stat = gini_vec, unbiased = unbiased))
  delta <- gamma_sub - mean(alpha)
  delta_null <- gamma_sub - perm[, "mean_alpha"]
  out <- data.frame(
    terraces_used = label,
    minimum_terraces = min_n,
    estimator = if (unbiased) "corrected" else "standard",
    sites = length(sub),
    terraces = length(vals),
    gamma = gamma_sub,
    mean_alpha = mean(alpha),
    beta = stats::sd(alpha),
    delta = delta,
    expected_mean_alpha = mean(perm[, "mean_alpha"]),
    expected_lo95 = unname(stats::quantile(perm[, "mean_alpha"], 0.025)),
    expected_hi95 = unname(stats::quantile(perm[, "mean_alpha"], 0.975)),
    expected_beta = mean(perm[, "beta"]),
    expected_delta = mean(delta_null),
    excess_delta = delta - mean(delta_null),
    p_delta = (sum(delta_null >= delta - 1e-12) + 1) / (length(delta_null) + 1),
    p_beta = (sum(perm[, "beta"] >= stats::sd(alpha) - 1e-12) + 1) / (nrow(perm) + 1)
  )
  if (!with_detail) return(list(summary = out))
  n_values <- sort(unique(sizes))
  draws <- do.call(rbind, par_reps(n_null, draw_alpha_once, seed + 1L, vals = vals, n_values = n_values, stat = gini_vec, unbiased = unbiased))
  curve <- data.frame(terraces = n_values, median = apply(draws, 2, stats::median), lo95 = apply(draws, 2, stats::quantile, 0.025), hi95 = apply(draws, 2, stats::quantile, 0.975))
  boot_alpha <- unlist(par_reps(n_boot, boot_mean_once, seed + 2L, vals = unname(alpha)))
  sites <- data.frame(Site_ID = names(sub), terraces = sizes, alpha = unname(alpha), alpha_corrected = unname(vapply(sub, gini_vec, numeric(1), unbiased = TRUE)), eta = (gamma_sub - unname(alpha)) / (length(vals) - sizes)) |>
    left_join(curve |> rename(expected_median = median, expected_lo95 = lo95, expected_hi95 = hi95), by = "terraces") |>
    mutate(below_expected_95 = alpha < expected_lo95, above_expected_95 = alpha > expected_hi95)
  list(summary = out, sites = sites, curve = curve, boot_alpha = boot_alpha)
}
ms_main <- time_step("Gini, within and across Tairona sites", multiscale_terraces(min_terraces_alpha, seed_base + 5000L, with_detail = TRUE))

  multiscale_terraces(min_terraces_alpha, seed_base + 5040L, unbiased = !gini_unbiased)$summary
))

  hs <- house_specs[[i]]

  s0 <- seed_base + 5060L + 10L * i
  bg <- unlist(par_reps(n_boot, boot_cluster_once, s0, vals_list = hs$vals, stat = gini_vec, unbiased = gini_unbiased))
  bt <- unlist(par_reps(n_boot, boot_cluster_once, s0 + 1L, vals_list = hs$vals, stat = top_share_of, top = top_fraction))
  cbind(data.frame(
    key = names(house_specs)[i],
    unit = hs$label,
    units = length(v),
    clusters = length(hs$vals),
    estimate = gini_vec(v, gini_unbiased),
    estimate_corrected = gini_vec(v, TRUE),
    top_share = top_share_of(v, top_fraction),
    top_lo95 = unname(stats::quantile(bt, 0.025)),
    top_hi95 = unname(stats::quantile(bt, 0.975))

}))

  units = ms_main$summary$terraces,

typ_boot <- unlist(par_reps(n_boot, boot_cluster_once, seed_base + 6020L, vals_list = terr_list_typ, stat = gini_vec, unbiased = gini_unbiased))
gini_typ_table <- bind_rows(
  gini_house |> filter(key == "terraces") |> transmute(terraces_used = "all terraces", units, estimate, lo80, hi80, lo95, hi95),
  cbind(data.frame(terraces_used = "without far outliers", units = length(unlist(terr_list_typ)), estimate = gini_vec(unlist(terr_list_typ, use.names = FALSE), gini_unbiased)), percentile_ranges(typ_boot)) |> select(terraces_used, units, estimate, lo80, hi80, lo95, hi95)
)
band_sites <- ms_main$sites |>
  filter(above_expected_95 | below_expected_95) |>
  left_join(site_diam, by = "Site_ID") |>
  left_join(ms_typ$sites |> select(Site_ID, alpha_without_far = alpha, above_band_without_far = above_expected_95, below_band_without_far = below_expected_95), by = "Site_ID") |>
  select(Site_ID, terraces, alpha, expected_lo95, expected_hi95, above_expected_95, max_diameter_m, far_outliers, alpha_without_far, above_band_without_far, below_band_without_far) |>
  arrange(desc(alpha))
lorenz_keys <- c("terraces", "sites")
lorenz_lab <- stats::setNames(c(
  paste0("Terraces, G = ", fmt_num(gini_house$estimate[gini_house$key == "terraces"], 3)),
  paste0("Sites, G = ", fmt_num(gini_house$estimate[gini_house$key == "sites"], 3))
), lorenz_keys)
lorenz_obs <- bind_rows(lapply(lorenz_keys, function(k) data.frame(curve = lorenz_lab[[k]], lorenz_curve(unlist(house_specs[[k]]$vals, use.names = FALSE)))))
lorenz_band <- time_step("Gini, Lorenz curve bands", bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(lorenz_keys), function(i) {
  k <- lorenz_keys[i]
  v <- unlist(house_specs[[k]]$vals, use.names = FALSE)
  m <- do.call(rbind, par_reps(n_boot, boot_cluster_once, seed_base + 5062L + 10L * i, vals_list = house_specs[[k]]$vals, stat = lorenz_at, grid = lorenz_grid))
  data.frame(curve = lorenz_lab[[k]], p = lorenz_grid, L = lorenz_at(v, lorenz_grid), lo95 = apply(m, 2, stats::quantile, 0.025), hi95 = apply(m, 2, stats::quantile, 0.975))
})))
lorenz_obs$curve <- factor(lorenz_obs$curve, levels = unname(lorenz_lab))
lorenz_band$curve <- factor(lorenz_band$curve, levels = unname(lorenz_lab))
gini_spec <- data.frame(
  var = c("decorated", "plain_step", "core", "serving"),
  den = c("n", "plain", "n", "fun_rec"),
  min_den = c(1, 1, 1, min_functional),
  label = c("Decorated", "Steps >= 1, undecorated", "Firing core", "Serving vessels")
)
gini_plot_lines <- c("Decorated", "Steps >= 1, undecorated")
gini_line <- function(j, pr, seed) {
  v <- gini_spec$var[j]
  dn <- gini_spec$den[j]
  up <- unit_period |> filter(Period == pr, qualified, .data[[dn]] >= gini_spec$min_den[j])
  if (nrow(up) < min_sites_period) return(NULL)
  ids <- up$Unit_ID
  dens <- up[[dn]]
  props <- up[[v]] / dens
  est <- gini_vec(props, gini_unbiased)
  if (!is.finite(est)) return(NULL)
  sh <- sherds |> filter(Period == pr, Unit_ID %in% ids)
  if (dn != "n") sh <- sh |> filter(.data[[dn]])
  num <- as.numeric(sh[[v]])
  stopifnot(length(num) == sum(dens))
  nul <- unlist(par_reps(n_null, null_gini_sherds_once, seed, num = num, sizes = dens, stat = gini_vec, unbiased = gini_unbiased))
  nul <- nul[is.finite(nul)]
  loc_tab <- sh |>
    group_by(Unit_ID, Location_ID) |>
    summarise(x_num = sum(.data[[v]]), x_den = n(), .groups = "drop")
  g_loc <- match(loc_tab$Unit_ID, ids)
  ord <- order(loc_tab$x_den, loc_tab$Location_ID)
  stratum <- integer(nrow(loc_tab))
  stratum[ord] <- ceiling(seq_along(ord) / location_stratum_size)
  strata_list <- split(seq_len(nrow(loc_tab)), stratum)
  check <- rowsum(loc_tab$x_num, g_loc)[, 1] / rowsum(loc_tab$x_den, g_loc)[, 1]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(g_loc), length(check) == length(ids), isTRUE(all.equal(unname(check), props)))
  nul_loc <- unlist(par_reps(n_null, null_gini_loc_once, seed + 1L, num_loc = loc_tab$x_num, den_loc = loc_tab$x_den, g = g_loc, strata_list = strata_list, stat = gini_vec, unbiased = gini_unbiased))
  nul_loc <- nul_loc[is.finite(nul_loc)]
  boot <- unlist(par_reps(n_boot, boot_cluster_once, seed + 2L, vals_list = as.list(props), stat = gini_vec, unbiased = gini_unbiased))
  cbind(data.frame(
    line = gini_spec$label[j],
    Period = pr,
    units = length(ids),
    sherds_in_denominators = sum(dens),
    estimate = est,
    estimate_corrected = gini_vec(props, TRUE),
    expected_by_chance = mean(nul),
    chance_lo95 = unname(stats::quantile(nul, 0.025)),
    chance_hi95 = unname(stats::quantile(nul, 0.975)),
    excess = est - mean(nul),
    ratio = est / mean(nul),
    p_chance = (sum(nul >= est - 1e-12) + 1) / (length(nul) + 1),
    expected_by_location_chance = mean(nul_loc),
    location_lo95 = unname(stats::quantile(nul_loc, 0.025)),
    location_hi95 = unname(stats::quantile(nul_loc, 0.975)),
    excess_over_locations = est - mean(nul_loc),
    p_location = (sum(nul_loc >= est - 1e-12) + 1) / (length(nul_loc) + 1),
    locations = nrow(loc_tab),
    location_strata = length(strata_list)
  ), percentile_ranges(boot))
}
gini_cer <- time_step("Gini coefficients of unit sherd proportions", bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(gini_spec)), function(j) {
  bind_rows(lapply(periods, function(pr) gini_line(j, pr, seed_base + 5100L + 100L * j + 10L * match(pr, periods))))
}))) |>
  mutate(line = factor(line, levels = gini_spec$label), Period = factor(Period, levels = periods))
print_block("Gini. Lines of evidence shown in Figure 6d", data.frame(line = gini_spec$label, shown = gini_spec$label %in% gini_plot_lines))
kinds_long <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(gini_spec)), function(j) {
  dn <- gini_spec$den[j]
  unit_period |>
    filter(qualified, .data[[dn]] >= gini_spec$min_den[j]) |>
    transmute(Period = as.character(Period), Unit_ID, line = gini_spec$label[j], value = .data[[gini_spec$var[j]]] / .data[[dn]])
}))
spearman_row <- function(a, b, label, pr) {
  ok <- is.finite(a) & is.finite(b)
  a <- a[ok]
  b <- b[ok]
  if (length(a) < min_sites_period || stats::sd(a) == 0 || stats::sd(b) == 0) return(NULL)
  sp <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(a, b, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  data.frame(Period = pr, comparison = label, units = length(a), spearman_rho = unname(sp$estimate), p = sp$p.value)
}
comp_tab <- sherds |>
  filter(Period == "Tairona", plain, Function %in% c("Cooking", "Storage")) |>
  group_by(Unit_ID) |>
  summarise(nonserving_undecorated = n(), steps_nonserving = mean(prod1), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(nonserving_undecorated >= min_functional) |>
  inner_join(kinds_long |> filter(Period == "Tairona", line == "Serving vessels") |> select(Unit_ID, serving = value), by = "Unit_ID")
comp_row <- spearman_row(comp_tab$steps_nonserving, comp_tab$serving, "Steps >= 1 on undecorated cooking and storage sherds with Serving vessels", "Tairona")
line_pairs <- utils::combn(gini_spec$label, 2, simplify = FALSE)
kinds7 <- bind_rows(
  bind_rows(lapply(periods, function(pr) bind_rows(lapply(line_pairs, function(lp) {
    w <- kinds_long |> filter(Period == pr, line %in% lp) |> select(Unit_ID, line, value) |> pivot_wider(names_from = line, values_from = value)
    if (!all(lp %in% names(w))) return(NULL)
    spearman_row(w[[lp[1]]], w[[lp[2]]], paste(lp[1], "with", lp[2]), pr)
  })))),
  bind_rows(lapply(gini_spec$label, function(lb) {
    w <- kinds_long |> filter(Period == "Tairona", line == lb) |> inner_join(site_area |> select(Unit_ID = Site_ID, mean_area_m2), by = "Unit_ID")
    spearman_row(w$mean_area_m2, w$value, paste("Mean terrace area with", lb), "Tairona")
  })),
  comp_row
) |>
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"))
```

## 28. Table 1, Q1 within-site differences between periods

```{r s28}
within_pairs <- function(var, pa, pb) {
  w <- frame_period |>
    filter(qualified, Period %in% c(pa, pb)) |>
    mutate(Period = as.character(Period)) |>
    select(Site_ID, Period, value = all_of(var)) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = Period, values_from = value)
  if (!all(c(pa, pb) %in% names(w))) return(numeric(0))
  ok <- !is.na(w[[pa]]) & !is.na(w[[pb]])
  w[[pa]][ok] - w[[pb]][ok]
}
attr_t1 <- c(p_decorated = "Decorated", p_plain_step = "Steps >= 1, undecorated", p_core = "Firing core")
empty_range <- data.frame(estimate = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, n_units = NA_real_, lo80 = NA_real_, hi80 = NA_real_, lo95 = NA_real_, hi95 = NA_real_, lo99 = NA_real_, hi99 = NA_real_)
t1_rows <- bind_rows(lapply(names(attr_t1), function(v) {
  bind_rows(lapply(pairs_list, function(pp) {
    d <- within_pairs(v, pp[1], pp[2])
    r <- if (length(d) >= min_pairs) mean_range(d) else empty_range
    cbind(data.frame(Comparison = paste0(attr_t1[[v]], ", ", pp[1], " minus ", pp[2])), r)
  }))
}))
t1_rows <- t1_rows |>
  mutate(t = estimate / se, p = ifelse(is.na(se), NA_real_, 2 * stats::pt(-abs(estimate / se), df = n_units - 1)))
t1_rows <- t1_rows |> mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(t1_rows))) if (!is.na(t1_rows$p[i])) register_p("Table 1", t1_rows$Comparison[i], t1_rows$p[i])
print_block("Table 1 support. Within-site differences with the number of paired sites and Holm-adjusted p values", format_p_columns(t1_rows, c("p", "p_holm")))
table1 <- data.frame(
  Comparison = t1_rows$Comparison,
  Pairs = as.integer(t1_rows$n_units),
  Difference = fmt_num(t1_rows$estimate, 3),
  Range80 = paste(fmt_num(t1_rows$lo80, 3), "to", fmt_num(t1_rows$hi80, 3)),
  Range95 = paste(fmt_num(t1_rows$lo95, 3), "to", fmt_num(t1_rows$hi95, 3)),
  Range99 = paste(fmt_num(t1_rows$lo99, 3), "to", fmt_num(t1_rows$hi99, 3)),
  t = fmt_num(t1_rows$t, 2),
  p = fmt_p(t1_rows$p),
  p_holm = fmt_p(t1_rows$p_holm)
)
names(table1) <- c("Comparison", "Paired sites", "Mean within-site difference", "80% error range", "95% error range", "99% error range", "t", "p", "Holm-adjusted p")
rownames(table1) <- NULL
stopifnot(ncol(table1) <= 9, nrow(table1) <= 10)
captions[["tab1"]] <- sprintf(captions[["tab1"]], min_sherds_site, num_word(sum(!is.na(t1_rows$p))))
stopifnot(nchar(captions[["tab1"]]) <= 350)
```

```{r s30}
print_block("Q3. Members of the smaller clusters", df9 |> filter(cluster != names(which.max(table(df9$cluster)))) |> select(Period, Unit_ID, Site_Type, cluster))
print_block("Q3. Scaling and clusters", data.frame(dimensions_plotted = k_plot, stress = stress9$stress[k_plot], spearman_input_configuration = shepard_rho, clusters = k_use, smallest_cluster = min(table(df9$cluster))), digits = 4)
print_block("Q4. Tairona quasibinomial regressions on terraces ordered by p value", format_p_columns(coef8 |> arrange(p) |> select(index, sites, odds_ratio_per_doubling, or_lower95, or_upper95, p, p_holm), c("p", "p_holm")), digits = 4)
print_block("Gini. Terrace area by unit of analysis and scale", gini_house |> transmute(unit = gsub("\n", " ", as.character(unit)), units, estimate, lo80, hi80, top_share, expected, p_delta = fmt_p(p_delta)), digits = 4)
print_block("Gini. Multiscalar decomposition of Tairona terrace area", ms_table |> transmute(terraces_used, minimum_terraces, estimator, sites, terraces, gamma, mean_alpha, beta, delta, expected_delta, excess_delta, p_delta = fmt_p(p_delta), p_beta = fmt_p(p_beta)), digits = 4)
print_block("Gini. Terrace area with and without far outlying terraces", gini_typ_table, digits = 4)
print_block("Gini. Correlation between finishing steps and serving vessels, with its compositional control", format_p_columns(kinds7 |> filter(grepl("Steps", comparison), grepl("Serving", comparison)), c("p", "p_holm")), digits = 4)
print_block("Gini. Unit sherd proportions against the two chance expectations", gini_cer |> transmute(line, Period, units, estimate, lo80, hi80, expected_by_chance, excess, p_chance = fmt_p(p_chance), expected_by_location_chance, excess_over_locations, p_location = fmt_p(p_location)), digits = 4)
```

## 32. Reporting audit of figure files and p values

```{r s32}
if (export_figures) {
  print_block("Figure files for submission", fig_files |> mutate(within_10_MB = tiff_mb < 10 & pdf_mb < 10), digits = 3)
  stopifnot(setequal(fig_files$figure, setdiff(grep("^Figure_", display_items, value = TRUE), "Figure_01")), all(fig_files$tiff_mb < 10), all(fig_files$pdf_mb < 10), all(fig_files$width_mm >= 80 & fig_files$width_mm <= 180), all(fig_files$dpi >= 300 & fig_files$dpi <= 600))
}
p_audit <- p_log |>
  mutate(p_formatted = fmt_p(p), minimum_resolvable = ifelse(resampling, 1 / (n_null + 1), NA_real_))
print_block("Reporting audit. Every p value reported in the numerical summaries and tables", p_audit, digits = 6)
print_block("Reporting audit. Number of p values by location", p_audit |> count(where))
print_block("Reporting audit. Smallest p value attainable with the chance and permutation replicates", data.frame(replicates = n_null, smallest_p = fmt_p(1 / (n_null + 1))))
stopifnot(
  nrow(p_audit) > 0,
  all(p_audit$p > 0),
  all(p_audit$p <= 1),
  all(p_audit$p[p_audit$resampling] >= 1 / (n_null + 1) - 1e-12),
  !any(p_audit$p_formatted %in% c("0", "0.000", "0.0000"))
)
```
